New Manhattan Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 12:34am

Ingredients




8 pkt Lemon Jello
3 3/4 quarts Hot water
3/4 cup Vinegar
1 1/2 teaspoons Salt
1 1/4 quarts Tart apples, chopped
3/4 quart Walnuts
1 quart Celery

Preparation

1 Dissolve Jello in hot water, add vinegar and salt. Chill until slightly thickened. Then fold in apples, chopped walnuts meats and celery, finely shredded. Pour in pan and chill until firm. Serve with mayonnaise dressing. 2 Serves 50.
